explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/447: must a union-free family of subsets of [n] (no A ∪ B = C with distinct A, B, C) have size o(2^n)? Yes (Sárközy–Szemerédi, then Kleitman). UnionFree uses Triplewise over pairwise-distinct triples. The statement asserts maxUnionFree n = o(2^n). Faithful.
